tools.name: lebenslauf_erstellen
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their German CV (Lebenslauf) laid out as a real, finished document. Pass only facts the user actually gave you. Returns an interactive preview card where the user can switch template and colour, download a watermarked PDF, or continue in the LebenslaufHeld editor. Run vollstaendigkeits_check first if you are unsure whether data is missing. Do not use this for cover letters (use anschreiben_erstellen).

tools.name: anschreiben_erstellen
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a German cover letter (Anschreiben) laid out as a finished German business letter. You write the paragraphs together with the user, based only on their real experience and the job ad; never invent numbers, names or achievements, and do not leave placeholders like [Firma]. Pass entwurf_id from lebenslauf_erstellen so sender data and design match the CV; otherwise pass absender. The salutation is built from empfaenger.name, so only fill it with a real contact person. Returns the same interactive preview card as the CV.

MCPAnschreiben.description:
Fertiger Anschreiben-Text, den das Client-Modell mit dem Nutzer geschrieben hat.

Die Anrede wird NICHT vom Modell uebernommen, sondern deterministisch aus
`empfaenger.name` gebaut (wie im Editor: keine erfundenen Namen).

schluss.description: Aktiver Schluss mit Gespraechswunsch, ggf. Eintrittstermin oder Gehaltsvorstellung, falls vom Nutzer genannt

tools.name: ats_check
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know whether their existing CV PDF can be read by applicant tracking systems (ATS). Purely technical and deterministic, no AI: text layer, fonts, date formats, standard headings. Pass the uploaded PDF as datei (or as pdf_base64). It does not judge the content.

MCPDatei.description: Datei-Objekt, wie ChatGPT es fuer openai/fileParams uebergibt.
MCPDatei.title: MCPDatei

tools.name: vollstaendigkeits_check
tools.description: Use this before lebenslauf_erstellen to check German CV data for missing contact details, gaps and empty sections. Rule based, no AI. The hints are editorial recommendations, not legal requirements, and never block the export.
